summary: A resident stays at a chore, such as spraying plants, and answers the canvasser from the yard.
realLife: A New Jersey account has a father spraying plants with ammonia who said he would vote for the next guy.
sources: Philadelphia Inquirer, NJ-3 Andy Kim and Tom MacArthur canvassing volunteers knock doors, 2018-10-22: https://www.inquirer.com/philly/news/new_jersey/shore/nj-3-andy-kim-tom-macarthur-election-2018-political-canvassing-volunteers-knock-doors-swing-left-20181022.html
